info.title: SORI iPad Exam API
info.description: Personal-practice iPad API with three immutable MusicXML questions (6/8, 4/4, 3/4), local piano playback and asynchronous OpenRouter AI grading and Korean feedback. AI values are estimates; API-CONTRACT.md defines invariants. Legacy v1 fixtures remain for regression checks. Playback v3 adds meter-matched, accented count-ins before both full replays, 20-second writing pauses and a final 120 seconds.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Persist one UUID per logical mutation. Reuse for transport retries; never regenerate on timeout. Scope: user + method + concrete path + key.

PlaybackPlan.description: Existing immutable attempts may use v2. New attempts use v3: initial 2 s, scale, 2 s, counted first full replay, 20 s after steps 1..10, counted final full replay, 120 s final writing. Release tails occupy the prescribed pauses and do not add 300 ms.

image.description: 2660 × 1692 PNG, RGB/RGBA without transparency, white background; maximum 10 MiB.

BBox.description: Top-left origin in the complete answer image. x+width <= 1, y+height <= 1. Width and height must be positive.

bbox.description: Top-left origin in the complete answer image. x+width <= 1, y+height <= 1. Width and height must be positive.

Grading.description: AI evaluation: conditional field invariants in API-CONTRACT.md. Scores are null unless completed. No deterministic 50:50 formula in ai-melodic-v1.

CountInPlayback.description: One measure before steps 1 and 11 only. Numerator clicks at denominator-note intervals; first velocity 110, others 70. Count-in and score share one MIDI clock. 6/8 has six eighth-note clicks.
